script:
local luckyBlocks = {
    ["SpawnLuckyBlock"] = "Lucky Block",
    ["SpawnSuperBlock"] = "Super Block",
    ["SpawnDiamondBlock"] = "Diamond Block",
    ["SpawnRainbowBlock"] = "Rainbow Block",
    ["SpawnGalaxyBlock"] = "Galaxy Block"
}
local blockNames = {}
for _, name in pairs(luckyBlocks) do
    table.insert(blockNames, name)
end
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()
local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Lucky Block Battlegrounds Script",
    Icon = "gamepad-2",
    LoadingTitle = "Loading...",
    LoadingSubtitle = "by lucaswewq1",
    ShowText = "Rayfield",
    Theme = "Amethyst", 
    ToggleUIKeybind = "K",
    DisableRayfieldPrompts = true,
    DisableBuildWarnings = true, 
    ConfigurationSaving = {Enabled = false},
    Discord = {Enabled = false},
    KeySystem = false
})
local luckyBlockChosen = "SpawnLuckyBlock"
local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Main")
local Dropdown = Tab:CreateDropdown({
    Name = "Select Lucky Block Type",
    Options = blockNames,
    CurrentOption = {blockNames[1]},
    MultipleOptions = false,
    Callback = function(selectedName)
        for key, value in pairs(luckyBlocks) do
            if value == selectedName then
                luckyBlockChosen = key
                break
            end
        end
    end,
})
local Button = Tab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Spawn Lucky Block",
    Callback = function()
        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild(luckyBlockChosen):FireServer()
    end
})
